The '''''Aurodia''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] warship that fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Ussin Fajinak]] was its first officer. Its first engagement was the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]].
